description: This PHP class 'EditJobVacancyController' extends an abstract controller and prepares a Vue component for editing a job vacancy. It sets properties such as vacancy ID, allowed file types, and maximum file size based on configuration services, to be rendered in the web interface.

classes.name: EditJobVacancyController
classes.description: Controller that manages the preparation of the Vue component for editing a job vacancy, including setting properties like vacancy ID, allowed file types, and maximum file size.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with job vacancy details and configuration properties before rendering.
